# Eventbrite

Eventbrite enables organizers to plan, promote, and manage events, selling tickets and providing attendee tools for conferences, concerts, and gatherings

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/eventbrite/.

## Actions

- **Get Event Categories**: Retrieve event categories.
- **Get Event Formats**: List event formats.
- **Get Event Subcategories**: List all event subcategories.
